text:
Alex R: Hey team — PR is ready but blocked on a design stamp from architecture. RFC linked here: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/rfc-412-quantized-routing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8620. TL;DR: add quantized kernel selection + routing changes for multi-model serving; introduces new fallback semantics for mismatched quantization profiles. Need architecture signoff on fallback behavior and KV-cache invalidation semantics before merge.

Priya K: quick Q — what is the user/customer impact if we delay this?

Alex R: No API surface changes. This is purely serving/runtime internal, opt-in via `enable_quant_routing` flag. Delay only affects perf improvements for customers on Dedicated. Expected 1.4-1.8x throughput on typical batching workloads.

Jordan T: please include a canary/rollout plan in the PR description with concrete thresholds (error % and latency SLOs) and rollback criteria. :eyes:

Alex R: added a canary plan to the PR: 10% traffic for 24h, 95th latency should not regress >10ms, error rate <0.1%. Rollback if either threshold breached. Also added the simple curl/traffic-script we use for canary verification.

Anil P: I'll review the RFC + PR today, ETA EOD. One thing I want to confirm: fallback semantics should prefer model correctness over throughput — please call that out explicitly in the RFC.

Alex R: done — updated RFC section 3.2 to state fallback prefers correctness and added sequence diagrams for fallback path. Also pushed a small unit test showing fallback preserves deterministic outputs.

eng-ci-bot: CI / build — all checks passed on commit 4f2d3b2 :white_check_mark:

Maya S: Security note — this touches KV cache encryption key usage. Please add a short KMS rotation/ownership note and confirm no new key material is stored in plaintext.

Alex R: good catch, added a security appendix describing KMS usage and rotation. Nothing persisted in plaintext, KV caches are encrypted at rest with customer-managed KMS where configured. @Maya S can you confirm?

Anil P: Reviewed. Left one nit about a comment in the fallback impl. RFC approved in tracker and linked in PR. Design LGTM pending that tiny nit. Once CI green and @Maya S gives security ack, you can merge. :thumbsup:

Alex R: Thanks @Anil P and everyone. I'll address the nit and wait for Maya's ack before merging.

Maya S: Confirmed — security review complete, no outstanding issues. KMS rotation note is fine.

Alex R: Great, merging once I push the small fix. Thanks all!
